name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement to downloads, playback, supported sources, or app workflows
title: ""
labels: ["enhancement"]
---

## What problem would this solve?

Describe a real situation in which the current downloader gets in your way.
Include the site, title, language, or workflow involved if relevant, and how you handle it today.

## What should change?

Describe the behavior you want. Say where it should be available: CLI/menu, Web UI, Auto-Sync, HTTP API, Discord bot, or the Python models.

## How should it work?

Give one concrete before/after example. A command, Web UI interaction, or example API request is enough; you do not need to design the implementation.

- Proposed command / interaction / request (if relevant):

```text
(example)
```

- Expected result:

```text
(result)
```

## Scope and defaults

Fill in what matters for your request:

- Should it be opt-in or enabled by default?
- Should it apply to one episode/title, one queue item, or all downloads?
- What should happen when the requested language, hoster, or source is unavailable?
- If it affects saved files, how should it interact with existing downloads and language-separated folders?

## New site / hoster requests (if applicable)

Include the site's URL and a public example title/episode page. Explain whether you want search/browse, extraction/download, or Web UI integration.
Mention any login, subscription, region restriction, or manual captcha needed to play it in a browser.

## Related work / alternatives (optional)

Link related issues or include screenshots. If an existing option or workaround nearly solves this, explain what is missing.

## Checklist

- [ ] I searched existing issues to avoid duplicates
